# Historical Volatility

*Annualised standard deviation of log returns, in percent.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Historical Volatility** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `10` |
| Periods per year | int | `365` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/hv.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Historical Volatility", shortTitle: "HV", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 10, { min: 2 });
const annual = input.int("Periods per year", 365, { min: 1 });
const lr = ta.calc([candle.close], (c) => math.log(c / candle.close.at(1)));
plot(ta.calc([ta.stdev(lr, length)], (s) => 100 * s * math.sqrt(annual)), { title: "HV", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
